name: After § 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text: 6a. Reiterates its full support for Colombia’s 2016 Peace Agreement and welcomes the Colombian Government’s willingness to accelerate its implementation; calls for the EU and its Member States to maintain and strengthen their support and funding for the Colombian Government’s policies backing the full implementation of the 2016 Peace Agreement; recognises, furthermore, the importance of funding civil society organisations that have been working for decades to build a peaceful country;
